clusters.mechanism: RuntimeCatalog edit validation filters persisted references against the old catalog, so references that a model addition makes live are never validated and the next startup throws.
RuntimePolicy filters retired operator references only at construction, so adding the missing model does not rebuild the policy and the stored override stays inactive until restart.
manageLocal builds new URL(`http://${remote_host}:8080`) without guarding it, so SSH destinations that are not valid URL hosts (IPv6, host:port, ssh://) throw an uncaught Invalid URL.

The remote provider is matched only by an exact origin of http://remote_host:8080, so providers on other ports, ssh_forward, or alias hosts are missed and the probe goes out unauthenticated with enablement skipped.
Eval resume and run retry pass stored requests through strict current-catalog validation, which rejects removed or retired model IDs and blocks resuming historical records.
The new removed-models tests depend on an absent evals/triage/cases.json and fail with ENOENT before exercising model validation.

Generic retired-reference filtering of stored prefer and operator cells replaces earlier explicit startup errors (model ID in prefer, REMOVED_MODELS explanations) with a misleading generic warning, and the covering test was deleted.
The change exceeds the source line budget by adding unrequested UI and unavailable-reference reporting.
Catalog-edit validation was relaxed to ignore all references that were already invalid before the edit, not just retired ones, and the test was inverted.
The smoke test's fixed backend list no longer includes any LAN llama.cpp provider, so it gets no structured-output check.
